# telnyx_traffic_policy_profile (Resource)

A traffic policy profile that allows or blocks services, IP ranges and domains for SIM cards, with an optional bandwidth limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let the SIM cards reach only the company's own domains and network.
resource "telnyx_traffic_policy_profile" "example" {
  type      = "whitelist"
  domains   = ["acme.example.com"]
  ip_ranges = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The type of the traffic policy profile. One of `blacklist`, `throttling`, `whitelist`.

### Optional

- `domains` (Set of String) Array of domain names.
- `ip_ranges` (Set of String) Array of IP ranges in CIDR notation.
- `limit_bw_kbps` (Number) Bandwidth limit in kbps.
- `services` (Set of String) Array of PCEF service IDs included in the profile.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_traffic_policy_profile.example <id>
```
